title: FTP UGM Receives PUAPT Site Visit to Strengthen Center of Excellence Sustainability
excerpt: Yogyakarta, August 5, 2026 – The Faculty of Agricultural Technology (FTP) Universitas Gadjah Mada received a Site Visit from the Inter-University Center of Excellence Program (PUAPT) organized by Universitas Gadjah Mada on Wednesday, August 5, 2026. body:
**Yogyakarta, August 5, 2026** – The Faculty of Agricultural Technology (FTP) Universitas Gadjah Mada received a Site Visit from the Inter-University Center of Excellence Program (PUAPT) organized by Universitas Gadjah Mada on Wednesday, August 5, 2026. The activity took place at the PUAPT laboratory of the Faculty of Agricultural Technology as part of the visiting agenda to various work units receiving the PUAPT program within UGM. The site visit was conducted to ensure the sustainability of the facilities and activities that have been developed through the PUAPT Program for Fiscal Year 2024.

One of the laboratories visited was the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri). On this occasion, the SmartAgri team introduced various innovations and research facilities supporting the development of precision agricultural technology, ranging from Internet of Things (IoT)-based smart agriculture systems, the use of drones and remote sensing, to the application of Artificial Intelligence in supporting decision-making in the agricultural sector. The various research presented demonstrated SmartAgri's commitment to producing technology-based solutions that are adaptive to the needs of modern agriculture.

During the activity, the SmartAgri team presented various development achievements, utilization of research equipment, and research activities that have been ongoing since the implementation of the PUAPT program. The visit also provided an opportunity for the evaluation team to directly observe the implementation of various research facilities used to support education and research. In addition to inspecting the laboratory infrastructure, discussions were held regarding the development of the center of excellence to ensure it continues to provide sustainable benefits for the academic community and the general public.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/856-1-image-1-1030x773.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/856-2-image-3-1030x773.webp)

This site visit activity was part of the evaluation process for the sustainability of facilities and activities that have been developed through the PUAPT Program. During the visit, the evaluation team directly inspected the utilization of research equipment, laboratory activities, and the implementation of various programs that have been carried out at the Faculty of Agricultural Technology. Additionally, the team obtained an understanding of the laboratory's contribution in supporting education and research activities. The results of this site visit are expected to serve as input for efforts to improve the quality of center of excellence management within UGM.

Through the implementation of the PUAPT Site Visit, FTP UGM reaffirms its commitment to continuously develop laboratories as centers for research, innovation, and collaboration that provide tangible impact for society. This activity is expected to support the sustainable development of centers of excellence at UGM while strengthening the university's contribution in producing innovations relevant to national needs. The spirit of collaboration and technological advancement being continuously developed is expected to serve as the foundation for advancing research and transformation of Indonesia's agricultural sector.

original.body:
**Yogyakarta, 5 Agustus 2026** – Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian (FTP) Universitas Gadjah Mada menerima kunjungan Site Visit Program Pusat Unggulan Antar Perguruan Tinggi (PUAPT) yang diselenggarakan oleh Universitas Gadjah Mada pada Rabu, 5 Agustus 2026. Kegiatan ini berlangsung di laboratorium PUAPT Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian sebagai bagian dari agenda kunjungan ke berbagai unit kerja penerima program PUAPT di lingkungan UGM. Site visit dilaksanakan untuk memastikan keberlanjutan pemanfaatan fasilitas dan aktivitas yang telah dikembangkan melalui Program PUAPT Tahun Anggaran 2024.

Salah satu laboratorium yang menjadi lokasi kunjungan adalah Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri). Pada kesempatan tersebut, tim SmartAgri memperkenalkan berbagai inovasi dan fasilitas penelitian yang mendukung pengembangan teknologi pertanian presisi, mulai dari sistem pertanian cerdas berbasis _Internet of Things_ (IoT), pemanfaatan drone dan penginderaan jauh, hingga penerapan kecerdasan buatan (_Artificial Intelligence_) dalam mendukung pengambilan keputusan di sektor pertanian. Berbagai penelitian yang dipresentasikan menunjukkan komitmen SmartAgri dalam menghasilkan solusi berbasis teknologi yang adaptif terhadap kebutuhan pertanian modern.

Dalam kegiatan tersebut, tim SmartAgri memaparkan berbagai capaian pengembangan, pemanfaatan peralatan penelitian, serta aktivitas riset yang telah berjalan sejak pelaksanaan program PUAPT. Kunjungan ini juga menjadi kesempatan bagi tim evaluator untuk melihat secara langsung implementasi berbagai fasilitas penelitian yang dimanfaatkan dalam mendukung pendidikan dan penelitian. Selain meninjau infrastruktur laboratorium, turut dilakukan diskusi mengenai pengembangan pusat unggulan agar tetap memberikan manfaat yang berkelanjutan bagi sivitas akademika maupun masyarakat luas.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/856-1-image-1-1030x773.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/856-2-image-3-1030x773.webp)

Kegiatan site visit ini merupakan bagian dari proses evaluasi terhadap keberlanjutan pemanfaatan fasilitas dan aktivitas yang telah dikembangkan melalui Program PUAPT. Selama kunjungan, tim evaluator meninjau secara langsung pemanfaatan peralatan penelitian, aktivitas laboratorium, serta implementasi berbagai program yang telah dijalankan di Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian. Selain itu, tim juga memperoleh gambaran mengenai kontribusi laboratorium dalam mendukung kegiatan pendidikan dan penelitian. Hasil dari site visit ini diharapkan dapat menjadi masukan dalam upaya peningkatan kualitas pengelolaan pusat unggulan di lingkungan UGM.

Melalui pelaksanaan Site Visit PUAPT, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian UGM menegaskan komitmennya untuk terus mengembangkan laboratorium sebagai pusat riset, inovasi, dan kolaborasi yang memberikan dampak nyata bagi masyarakat. Kegiatan ini diharapkan dapat mendukung keberlanjutan pengembangan pusat unggulan di UGM sekaligus memperkuat kontribusi perguruan tinggi dalam menghasilkan inovasi yang relevan dengan kebutuhan nasional. Semangat kolaborasi dan pemanfaatan teknologi yang terus dikembangkan diharapkan mampu menjadi fondasi bagi kemajuan riset dan transformasi sektor pertanian Indonesia.
